entities.summary: Hans Lennart Andersson-Tvilling is a Swedish former ice hockey player and footballer. He competed at the 1952 and 1956 Winter Olympics, winning a bronze medal in 1952 and finishing fourth in 1956 alongside his twin brother Stig. In addition to hockey, he also played four international matches for the Swedish association football team.
